title: Evaluating Quantized Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure aspects of faith or religion. It evaluates the performance of quantized LLMs on general NLP tasks, emergent abilities, trustworthiness (including ethics), dialogue, and long-context tasks. The 'ETHICS' benchmark used measures knowledge of basic concepts of morality from perspectives like commonsense moral, justice, deontology, virtue ethics, and utilitarianism, not religious doctrines.
findings: The paper does not contain findings related to religion.
